paragraphs: Dr.M.RamaKrishna, B.Tech, M.Tech,Ph.D is a Associate Professor and Head of the M.Tech(TE),He has completed Ph.D in Thermal Engineering from JNTUH, Master Degree in Structural Engineering from AVCERC,Nalgonda,and Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from KLR Engineering College.
